name: SA 330 Puma / IAR 330
armament: SOCAT: chin 20 mm THL-20 cannon, 57 mm rocket pods, Spike-ER ATGM on stub pylons
protection: Unarmoured airframe. Game: any calibre can damage; 7.62x54R and larger can bring it down with sustained fire; MANPADS and launchers destroy it.
visual_notes: Width given is main-rotor diameter (15 m); fuselage 14.06 m
Four-blade main rotor, twin turbines in a fairing above the cabin, tail rotor on the right of the tail boom
Large sliding cabin doors on both sides, retractable tricycle undercarriage with sponson fairings
SOCAT: chin turret cannon, stub pylons with rockets and missiles, nose sensor turret
